meta.title: Marikina City services (Citizen's Charter)

sources.covers: Fees, processing time, requirements and office for each service, 2022 edition
Per-office Citizen's Charter PDFs (40 files, text layer). Used for the office index: office name, edition, PDF link and SHA-256, and external service titles where the PDF text could be read in full.

meta.notes: Only services read directly from the 2022 Citizen's Charter are listed (12 of the charter's many services); all other services are carry-over (see sprint blockers). Fees stated as "Based on ..." are ordinance-based in the charter itself. Processing times are as printed. The 2022 edition may be outdated; newer per-office charters are listed at fdpp.marikina.gov.ph/citizen-charter and were not compared. Staff names printed in the charter are deliberately omitted. Sprint 03 added `charterIndex`: the 40 per-office charters on the Full Disclosure Portal (edition 2024, BPLO 2026). Only service titles are listed; fees, requirements and processing times are not transcribed (the PDF tables do not extract reliably) and are in the linked PDF. Offices whose external service list could not be read in full have externalServices null.

services.title: New Business Registration
services.description: Register a new business and get the permit assessed, billed and paid at the Treasury Office.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City (Chapters 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13, 26, 30, 33); quarterly payments due Jan 20, Apr 20, Jul 20 and Oct 20
services.processingTime: File 15 minutes; pay 15 minutes (walk-in or online)
requirements: Zoning clearance, 1 photocopy (integrated in the BPLS; if non-compliant, go to the City Planning Office)
Photo of the establishment showing the permanent signboard and sidewalk, and a vicinity sketch
DTI registration (sole proprietorship), SEC registration with Articles and Bylaws (corporation or partnership) or CDA registration (cooperative), 1 photocopy
Proof of the place of business: tax declaration (owned), notarized lease (rented), notarized consent letter (free use) or waiver and HOA certificate (settlement area)
Certificate to process from the Bureau of Fire Protection (Marikina Central Fire Station, Shoe Avenue)
If a representative (sole proprietorship): authorization letter or SPA from the owner, and valid IDs of the owner and representative
If a representative (corporation or partnership): Secretary's Certificate, authorization letter from the corporate secretary, and valid IDs of the secretary and representative
Some business types need more clearances (e.g. ECC for gas stations, DOE for LPG, TESDA NC II for spas) and public liability insurance (Ord. 32 s. 2013); see the charter

services.title: Renewal of Business Permit
services.description: Renew an existing business permit through the BPLO or online.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City; quarterly payments due Jan 20, Apr 20, Jul 20 and Oct 20
services.processingTime: File 15 minutes; pay 15 minutes (walk-in or online)
requirements: eBOSS compliance (Engineering, BFP, CHO, CEMO); check status at bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client
Financial statement, quarterly VAT returns or monthly percentage tax (photocopies)
If a representative (sole proprietorship): authorization letter or SPA from the owner, and valid IDs of the owner and representative
If a representative (corporation or partnership): Secretary's Certificate, authorization letter from the corporate secretary, and valid IDs of the secretary and representative
Public liability insurance (Ord. 32 s. 2013)

services.title: Change of Business Ownership
services.description: Amend a business registration to change the owner (single proprietorship or corporation).
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City
requirements: Single proprietorship: DTI registration, affidavit of change of ownership, deed of conveyance, original business permit, authorization letter, valid IDs
Corporation to corporation: SEC amended registration, board resolution, Secretary's Certificate, original business permit, authorization letter, valid IDs
Public market stalls: goodwill/deed of assignment, market clearance, treasurer's clearance, death certificate and affidavit of agreement (where applicable)

services.title: Payment of Business Tax
services.description: Pay business tax at the Treasury Office using the BIN and the tax billing from the BPLO.
services.fee: Based on the assessment of the business
services.processingTime: About 3 minutes at the window (30-second queue number)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: Business Identification Number (BIN)
Previous official receipt / tax billing from the BPLO

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
services.description: Get a Community Tax Certificate (cedula) at the Treasury Office.
services.fee: Based on the taxpayer's income
services.processingTime: About 2 minutes at the window (30-second queue number)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: Duly accomplished Community Tax Certificate (CTC) form (from the Treasury Help Desk)

services.title: Payment of Professional Tax
services.description: Annual professional tax for persons legally authorized to practice a profession; payable on or before January 31.
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
requirements: PRC or IBP identification card
Previous receipt

services.title: Real Property Tax Clearance
services.description: Certifies that real property tax payments are complete and up to date, for sale or loan transactions.
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Real Property Tax Division
requirements: Registered owner: photocopy of the current RPT official receipt and photocopy of a valid ID

Representative/buyer: photocopy of the current RPT official receipt, authorization letter or SPA from the owner, photocopies of the owner's and representative's valid IDs, and photocopies of the documents to be used in the sale or loan

services.title: Police Clearance (Payment of Fee)
services.description: Get an order of payment at the police station, then pay the fee at the Treasury cashier for the police clearance (employment, passport/visa, firearms, change of name, etc.).
services.fee: Based on the order of payment
services.processingTime: Order of payment 5 minutes, then payment at the cashier
services.office: Marikina Police Station and Treasury Cashier
requirements: Order of payment issued by the Police Station

services.title: Locational Clearance for Building Permit
services.description: Required before a building permit; checks that the building conforms with the Comprehensive Land Use Plan and zoning ordinance.
services.fee: Based on the order of payment (computed by the Planning Office; paid at the Treasury cashier)
services.processingTime: Simple transactions 5 days; highly technical transactions 20 days
requirements: 2 sets of complete plans (architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing)
Barangay clearance for construction
Lot plan signed and sealed by a geodetic engineer (2 sets)
Bill of materials signed and sealed by a licensed engineer/architect
Proof of ownership (certified true copy of the latest title, tax declaration of land and improvement)
Contract of lease (if renting)
Affidavit of undertaking
Notarized authorization letter or Secretary's Certificate for a representative
Notarized consent of immediate neighbors if needed
Other clearances under the 2005 National Building Code where necessary

charter.ref: City Planning and Development Office, p. 134; fees p. 102-103

services.title: Building Permit and Ancillary Permits
services.description: Processing and issuance of building and ancillary permits under the National Building Code (PD 1096).
services.fee: Based on the Philippine Electrical Code, Mechanical Code and National Building Code fee schedules
services.processingTime: 1 day and 3 hours in total (as stated in the charter)
requirements: TCT, tax declaration, tax receipt, bill of materials, specifications, CSHP certificate from DOLE, locational clearance
Signed and sealed construction plans (architectural, structural, lot plan, electrical, sanitary, mechanical)
Other government agency clearances as required

charter.ref: Office of the Building Official, p. 139

services.title: Sanitation and Health Certificate Fees
services.description: Pay sanitation and health certificate fees at the Treasury cashier after an order of payment from the City Health Office.
services.fee: Based on the order of payment
services.processingTime: Order of payment 5 minutes, then payment at the cashier
services.office: City Health Office and Treasury Cashier
requirements: Order of payment issued by the Health Office

services.title: Online Business Registration and Payment
services.description: Register and pay business fees online through the city's BPLO portal and online payment site.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City
requirements: Register on the BPLO portal (https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client/index)
Pay through https://payment.marikina.gov.ph/

services.title: Birth Registration (On-time)
services.description: Register a birth in Marikina City within 30 days of the date of birth.
services.fee: PHP 100.00 registration fee
services.whoMayAvail: Parents, guardians, the attendant at birth, hospitals and lying-in clinics
requirements: Municipal Form 102 (Certificate of Live Birth), 1 set, signed in black ink
If the parents are married: certified true copy or PSA copy of their marriage contract
If the parents are not married: notarized Affidavit of Admission of Paternity (back of Form 102) and Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (4 copies)

services.title: Late Birth Registration
services.description: Register a birth in Marikina City more than 30 days after the date of birth.
services.fee: Late registration fee: PHP 200.00 (30 days up to 1 year late); PHP 400.00 (2 years and above)
services.processingTime: Depends on the verification of the documents submitted
services.whoMayAvail: Parents, guardians, the attendant at birth, or the person whose birth was not registered (if of legal age)
requirements: Municipal Form 102 (Certificate of Live Birth), 1 set, signed in black ink
Notarized Affidavit of Delayed Registration of Birth
Affidavit of two disinterested persons
Negative certification from PSA (1 original)
Notarized affidavit of non-baptism (if of another religion)
Barangay clearance for late registration
Any 2 documents showing the date and place of birth (e.g. baptismal certificate, school record)
Proof of the parents' identity (PSA birth or marriage certificate, government ID or passport of the parents)
Parents married or not married: same marriage contract or paternity affidavits as on-time registration

services.title: Marriage License Application
services.description: Apply for a marriage license. At least one applicant must be a Marikina resident.
services.fee: PHP 100.00 application fee + PHP 300.00 marriage license fee
services.whoMayAvail: Single persons aged 18 and above who intend to marry; at least one must reside in Marikina
requirements: Municipal Form 90 (Application for Marriage License)
Personal appearance of both applicants
Valid government-issued or company ID
PSA or local civil registry birth certificate, or baptismal certificate, of both applicants
PSA Certificate of No Marriage Record (CENOMAR)
Community Tax Certificate (cedula)
2x2 photo of each applicant
Ages 18-25: parental consent or advice, with the parents present
Pre-marriage orientation and counseling, if applicable
Foreigners: passport copy and Certificate of Legal Capacity to Marry; if divorced, the final divorce decree

services.title: Death Registration (On-time)
services.description: Register a death that occurred in Marikina City within 30 days of the date of death.
services.fee: PHP 100.00 registration fee + PHP 150.00 certified true copy
services.whoMayAvail: Families of people who died in Marikina, and funeral parlors
requirements: Municipal Form 103 (Certificate of Death), 1 set, signed in black ink
Medical certificate and certification of death
Certification of embalmer
Burial, cremation or transfer permit (City Health Office)
Autopsy report, if applicable

services.title: Late Death Registration
services.description: Register a death that occurred in Marikina City more than 30 days after the date of death.
services.fee: PHP 200.00 late registration fee + PHP 150.00 certified true copy
services.whoMayAvail: Families of people who died in Marikina, and funeral parlors
requirements: Municipal Form 103 (Certificate of Death), 1 set, signed in black ink
Negative result from PSA (1 original, 1 photocopy)
Notarized Affidavit of Delayed Registration of Death (back of Form 103)
Medical certificate and certification of death
Certificate of burial (cemetery) and certificate of service (funeral parlor)
Certification of embalmer
Burial, cremation or transfer permit (City Health Office)
Autopsy report, if applicable

services.title: Certified True Copy of Birth, Marriage or Death Certificate
services.description: Get a certified true copy of a birth, marriage or death certificate registered in Marikina.
services.fee: PHP 150.00 per copy
requirements: Request form (Window 4)
Valid government-issued ID of the requester and of any authorized representative
Authorization letter or special power of attorney, if not the document owner

services.title: Change of First Name (RA 9048)
services.description: Petition to change a first name or nickname in a civil registry record without going to court.
services.fee: PHP 3,000.00 filing fee; PHP 500.00 more for a migrant petition; newspaper publication for 2 weeks starts at PHP 2,500.00 (paid to the newspaper)
services.processingTime: 2-3 months (includes approval by the PSA Legal Division)
services.whoMayAvail: The record owner or their spouse, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, guardian or authorized representative, of legal age
requirements: PSA copy of the certificate to be changed, with 2 photocopies
Certificate of employment with no pending case, or affidavit of non-employment
Current NBI clearance and police clearance (for change of first name)
Documents showing the correct entry (e.g. baptismal certificate, school records, SSS/GSIS, IDs); the processor decides which apply
RA 9048 Form 4.1 petition (3 notarized originals)
Other documents the Civil Registrar may require

services.title: Correction of Clerical Error (RA 9048)
services.description: Petition to correct a clerical or typographical error in a civil registry record without going to court.
services.fee: PHP 1,000.00 filing fee; PHP 500.00 more for a migrant petition
services.whoMayAvail: The record owner or their spouse, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, guardian or authorized representative, of legal age
requirements: PSA copy of the certificate to be corrected, with 2 photocopies
Documents showing the correct entry (e.g. birth certificates of siblings or children, baptismal certificate, school records); the processor decides which apply
RA 9048 petition form (LCRO)
Other documents the Civil Registrar may require

services.title: Correction of Sex or Day and Month of Birth (RA 10172)
services.description: Petition to correct the sex, or the day and month of birth, in a birth certificate without going to court.
services.fee: PHP 3,000.00 filing fee; PHP 500.00 more for a migrant petition; newspaper publication for 2 weeks starts at PHP 2,500.00 (paid to the newspaper)
services.processingTime: 2-3 months (includes approval by the PSA Legal Division)
services.whoMayAvail: The record owner or their spouse, children, parents, siblings, grandparents, guardian or authorized representative, of legal age
requirements: PSA copy of the birth certificate, with 2 photocopies
Current NBI clearance and police clearance
Documents showing the correct entry; the processor decides which apply
RA 10172 Form 4.1 petition (notarized)
Other documents the Civil Registrar may require

services.title: Payment of Real Property Tax
services.description: Pay real property tax (amilyar) at the Treasury Office or online at payment.marikina.gov.ph.
services.fee: Based on the assessment of the property
services.processingTime: About 4 minutes at the window (30-second queue number)
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Real Property Tax Division
services.whoMayAvail: Owners and developers of real property in Marikina
requirements: Account number or Property Identification Number (PIN), from the previous official receipt
Statement of account (from the teller)
Online: create an account, register each property by PIN, compute the tax, then pay

services.title: Payment of Transfer Tax
services.description: Pay the tax on the sale, donation or other transfer of real property in Marikina.
services.fee: 75% of 1% of the selling price or the fair market value, whichever is higher
services.office: City Treasurer's Office, Business Tax Division
services.whoMayAvail: Sellers, buyers, heirs, donors and donees of real property in Marikina
requirements: Deed of transfer
Tax declaration (City Assessor's Office)
Tax clearance (City Treasurer's Office)
TCT, original or certified true copy (Register of Deeds)
Authorization letter or SPA, if a representative
Valid ID of the owner and representative
Photocopies of all the documents above

services.title: Retirement of Business
services.description: Close a business and retire its permit with the BPLO.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City (Chapter 4, Secs. 25 and 32)
requirements: Original business permit
Business plate
Photocopy of the latest business permit receipt
Notarized application for business retirement
Financial statements (prior and current year)
If a representative (sole proprietorship): authorization letter or SPA from the owner, and valid IDs of the owner and representative
If a representative (corporation or partnership): Secretary's Certificate, authorization letter from the corporate secretary, and valid IDs of the secretary and representative

services.title: Business Certification
services.description: Certification of no record on file, amendments, retirement, registration or status of a business.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City (Chapter 22, Sec. 103(b))
requirements: Request letter
If a representative (sole proprietorship): authorization letter or SPA from the owner, and valid IDs of the owner and representative
If a representative (corporation or partnership): Secretary's Certificate, authorization letter from the corporate secretary, and valid IDs of the secretary and representative

services.title: Certified True Copy of Business Documents
services.description: Get a certified true copy of a business record from the BPLO.
services.fee: Based on the Revenue Code of Marikina City (Chapter 22, Sec. 103(b))
requirements: Request letter
If a representative (sole proprietorship): authorization letter or SPA from the owner, and valid IDs of the owner and representative
If a representative (corporation or partnership): Secretary's Certificate, authorization letter from the corporate secretary, and valid IDs of the secretary and representative

services.title: Health Certificate (Health Card)
services.description: Get a health certificate or health card, e.g. for employment or food handling.
services.fee: PHP 150.00 health card + PHP 150.00 X-ray
services.office: City Health Office, Medical Employees Clinic
requirements: Checklist form (laboratory clinic)
Urine and stool samples
Recent 1x1 colored photo
X-ray result from within the last 6 months

services.title: Sanitary Permit
services.description: Sanitary permit for a business, issued with the business permit.
services.fee: PHP 300.00 (integrated in the business permit)
requirements: Business permit (BPLO)

services.title: Burial, Cremation, Exhumation and Transfer Permit
services.description: Permit to bury, cremate, exhume, rebury or transfer the remains of a person.
services.fee: Burial PHP 400.00 (public cemetery) or PHP 500.00 (private); cremation PHP 300.00; transfer PHP 300.00 within the Philippines or PHP 700.00 abroad; exhumation and reburial from PHP 300.00
requirements: Original death certificate (hospital, Civil Registry or funeral parlor)

services.title: Anti-Rabies Vaccination
services.description: Free anti-rabies vaccination at the Animal Bite Treatment Center.
services.fee: Free
services.processingTime: About 20 minutes, plus 30 minutes of observation for the ERIG test
services.office: City Health Office, Animal Bite Treatment Center
requirements: Referral letter from a health center
Employee ID or any valid ID with proof of residency

services.title: Primary Health Care (Health Centers)
services.description: Free check-ups, consultation and medicines at the barangay health centers.
services.fee: Free
requirements: Accomplished patient's information form (from the health center staff)

services.title: Clinical Laboratory Tests
services.description: Low-cost blood, urine and stool tests at the CHO laboratory with a doctor's request.
services.fee: PHP 50.00 each (blood typing, urinalysis, fecalysis); PHP 100.00 each (FBS, BUN, creatinine, uric acid, cholesterol, triglycerides, HDL/LDL, SGPT, SGOT, hemoglobin/hematocrit); CBC PHP 200.00; RPR/VDRL PHP 200.00; Hepa B screening PHP 175.00; HbA1c PHP 500.00
services.whoMayAvail: Anyone with a request from a licensed doctor
requirements: Referral or request form from a licensed physician
